symbols.name: Symbol_CLivePreview__FadeOutToGlass
symbols.notes: 28000.1/1896/3231 Activate consumes only HRESULT and reloads subsequent arguments; no private volatile-register dependency at the direct call. FadeOutToGlass retains existing clones on reversal and restarts the native timeline from its current opacity.

symbols.name: Symbol_CLivePreview__UpdateResources
symbols.notes: OnWindowShowHide keeps its continuation state in stack/nonvolatile registers on 28000.1/1896/3231. Per-monitor enumeration copies temporary resources into a vector; their destruction removes display visuals from their parents, so attach only after the complete update returns. On 28000.3231, CVisualBrush::Reset retains its visual surface, while dwmcore CVisualSurface::Freeze/GetExplicitRealizationSizeCVI skip an already frozen capture. Release old capture pairs before rebuilding resources so new bounds cannot reuse an old snapshot.
